Limits: Indicator scanner, not comprehensive antivirus. No firmware eradication, no hidden-root guarantee, no network traffic inspection. Ordinary Android app cannot delete /system or kill other apps on Android 14+. Uninstall operates within the current Android user/profile. Firmware remediation requires a separate explicit, verified procedure.
